evals.name: velocity-board-screenshot
evals.prompt: Here's our VeloCity event storming board: velocity/velocity-processes.jpg. Find the bounded contexts on it. I'm the trainer, by the way, so you can't spoil anything for me.
evals.expected_output: Reads the board back first; H1 pivots then H2 lanes then H3 single responsibility, each round ending in numbered questions; per-context critic verdicts; finds the account-blocking duplication, splits Debt Recovery from Payments, finds the settlement gap (ideally before the expert asks); ~8 contexts each with one question; report file written; no CML, no canvases (expert declined).

Debt Recovery is a separate context from Payments

evals.name: validate-velocity-reference-cml
evals.prompt: can you sanity-check the VeloCity context map in src/main/cml/VeloCity-Context-Map.cml? I wrote it as the reference solution for the workshop and I want to know if it breaks any of our context mapping rules before I show it to the group.
evals.expected_output: Validate mode; runs the validator; walks the processes; findings tied to the rules (the Accounts->Rentals->Settlement->Accounts indirect cycle, the many Conformists that need justification, downstreams without ACL, the unconfirmed CustomerSupport relationship); critic in map mode; proposed corrected map as a separate valid CML file; original CML untouched.
assertions: Original src/main/cml/VeloCity-Context-Map.cml left unmodified
Proposed corrected map delivered as a separate CML file that passes validate_cml.sh
Final message is under 400 words
Flags the indirect upstream/downstream cycle Accounts -> Rentals -> Settlement -> Accounts
Flags the Conformist relationships and asks for or evaluates their justification
Flags downstream contexts without an ACL (e.g. Rentals from Accounts, FleetMaintenance from CustomerSupport)
Points out the unconfirmed CustomerSupport -> FleetMaintenance relationship
Walks at least one business process step by step through the map
Ties each finding to an explicit context-mapping rule rather than generic advice
An independent critic reviewed the map and its verdict is reported
The unconfirmed CustomerSupport -> FleetMaintenance relationship is confirmed, changed or removed by the expert, not just relabelled
The proposed map adds no new unconfirmed relationships
Critic use is proportionate: no blanket per-context critics when no context was flagged, and at most one map critic pass unless it disagreed
The cycle fix itself is confirmed by the expert, not decided unilaterally
